section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single present study (Study X) that examined multiple dimensions of positive body image and their associations with sexual outcomes. The authors recruited an online sample of US adults (including both women and men), included measures of body appreciation and related constructs, and controlled for sexual orientation and relationship status in analyses.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The present study was designed to address some of these limitations in the literature."; "we included measures of body appreciation (...) Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005; Tylka & Wood-Barcalow, 2015b"; "we sampled both women and men to examine the extent to which uncovered associations were true of both genders. We also avoided a reliance on college students by recruiting an online sample of US adults."
